text.title: Hourglass Rescue
text.body: Imperial inquisitors have locked Gate Warden Lyra and a company of Thornwick craftsmen and Oakhaven shipwrights inside the lower tidal vaults as the Western Sea's high tide surges in. Shatter every barricade before the countdown expires and the rising water drowns the cell-grates.
text.obj.0: Break the siege and reach the North Gatehouse vaults in time
text.obj.1: Keep Gate Warden Lyra and the trapped shipwrights alive
text.msg.1: The tide is surging through the cell-grates and the hourglass is turned! Push straight north—Thornwick craftsmen and half of Oakhaven's shipwrights are locked inside these flooding vaults!
text.msg.2: Half the sand has fallen and freezing water laps at our waists—smash through the gorge barricades!
text.msg.3: The cell-grates are submerging and the timbers splinter—only moments remain!
text.msg.4: The drowned locks burst open! Every shipwright and craftsman is pulled clear—march straight to Master Kors's slipways at Harborwatch!
text.win: The tidal vaults burst open before the tide claimed them, doubling hull construction at Master Kors's slipways.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell on the rescue march.
text.fail.2: The hourglass emptied and the rising tide submerged the North Gatehouse vaults.
text.fail.3: Gate Warden Lyra was slain before the trapped shipwrights could escape.
